The '''Tactical Command Officer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He was stationed in the Imperial outpost of [[Camp Conquest]], where he was killed when the base was [[Mission to Balmorra (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|attacked]] by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] in [[3642 BBY]]
